settings.text: "I spent weeks trying to figure out what the Wanderosa was. In the end, I realised Salsa already knew: it's an exploration bike. Its greatest strength isn't speed, capability or even comfort, though it offers all three in abundance. It's an invitation to explore and go further. To turn down the unknown road. To investigate that logging track you've always wondered about. To venture farther from home knowing the suspension will smooth the terrain and the motor will help get you back again. The Wanderosa is a purpose-built machine for riders who simply want to see what's around the next bend and the next and the next."

settings.title: "As someone who regularly rides a gravel bike, it is cool and freaky to ride a bike that is, to all appearances, a gravel bike, but then feels like a very cushy, premium electric mountain bike once you're on it. It's like nibbling what looks like a bit of bitter dark chocolate, and finding it full of puffy, sweet marshmallow."
settings.text: Review: Salsa Wanderosa Electric Gravel Bike, Wired.com | Feb 26, 2026

settings.title: "The feel out back is incredible. It’s so plush I want to check my tires. I love the steady handling on loose dirt. The overall feel of this bike, I love."
settings.text: Supreme ride: New Salsa Flyway race-tested at Rouge Roubaix, The Ride with Ben Delaney | March 12, 2026

settings.title: "This sounds like classic marketing jargon, but as my first experience putting in hundreds of miles with a VRS-equipped frame, I can honestly say it feels quite nice. While my review Flyway wasn’t exactly like comparing apples to apples with other rigid gravel bikes because of the suspension fork it came with, the whole package was one of the most comfortable race-oriented gravel bikes I’ve ridden. I can’t quantify the percentage difference in rear-end damping over other bikes, but my main takeaway from riding the suspension-equipped Flyway in a variety of rough terrain is that it’s a fast and efficient pedaler that didn’t leave me feeling underbiked even through some sustained sections of chunky singletrack or really rough, unmaintained roads."
settings.text: Salsa Flyway and Otso Waheela R: Comparison review, escapecollective.com | March 12, 2026

settings.title: "I truly think this is one of the fastest gravel bikes on the market."
settings.text: Salsa Flyway Review! (Fastest Gravel Bike in 2026?), Awesome MTB (Mo and Hannah) | March 12, 2026

settings.title: "The Salsa Blackthorn is a bike that supports everyday adventures. From your local trail center to the bike park, it offers a fun, efficient, and engaging ride across the spectrum. The rear end always remained active and plush on the descents and continually impressed, no matter the terrain I pushed it through. Yet this was contrasted by solid efficiency on the way back up the hill. It’s not perfect, but it’s a damn fun all-round trail bike."
settings.text: Salsa Blackthorn 145 Review: The Little Bike That Can Do It All, theloamwolf.com | January 12, 2026

settings.title: "The Salsa Spearfish has been a killer little bike, with a speedy and efficient feel while pedaling and surprisingly fun traits when you point things downhill. Though it's billed as an XC bike, this frame could be many things depending on how you build it. For the most part, the geometry feels forward-thinking, and the suspension performance is quite good for the intended purpose."
settings.text: Review: Salsa's New Spearfish - The Bright Green Race Machine, pinkbike.com | April 10, 2025

settings.title: "The Salsa Notch’s seating position was comfortable for all of our test crew, and even left Drew feeling in the most commanding seated position of all of the bikes...Salsa developed their Notch with steep and gnarly terrain in mind, and that’s exactly where the bike shone during testing"
settings.text: Salsa Notch Deore Review: Big Burly Budget Bike, theloamwolf.com | 2024

settings.title: "I only spent a short time with the Tributary and it felt at home as I have spent some time on the past two iterations of the Cutthroat. The Tributary feels like the 2024 geometry inflation-corrected version of the Cutthroat."
settings.text: Salsa Cycles Tributary E-Bike Review: A Great Documentary Tool, theradavist.com | June 20, 2024

settings.title: "At first glance, some might see the Salsa Cutthroat as a gravel bike on steroids. But at its heart, the Cutthroat is truly a mountain bike designed for speed and long rides. Its design includes ample space to carry everything needed for a long adventure. It’s perfect for those who enjoy long mixed-terrain rides and prioritize comfort, with the capability to handle trails that diverge from gravel roads."
settings.text: Our 13 Favorite Drop-Bar MTBs + History and Interpretation, bikepacking.com | July 18, 2024

settings.title: "We found ourselves beyond stoked with the Rangefinder, thanks to its accessible price, ample mounting points for bikepacking gear and 120 millimeters of suspension."
settings.text: The 12 best mountain bikes of 2024, according to biking enthusiasts, cnn.com | October 01, 2024

settings.title: "The latest Timberjack builds are quite impressive and the ride quality sets a high standard for what an aluminum hardtail can do."
